description: This pie chart details the distribution of stimulus types used in a study, as indicated by the central label “Stimulus Type.” The chart contains seven slices representing different categories. The largest slice, colored maroon, is labeled “Draft/Other” and represents 26.4% of the total. “Press Release” is represented by a yellow slice at 18.7%, followed by “External News Article” in teal at 18.1%. A light green slice represents “Email” at 2.7%, while a purple slice indicates “Event Posting” at 6.6%. “Organizational Report” is shown as a dark teal slice at 7.7%, and “Organizational Website” is a blue slice representing 4.9%. Finally, “Intra-agency news article” is a dark green slice at 4.9% and “Interview” is a gray slice at 8.8%. The chart includes a legend labeling each slice, and percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a descending order based on their proportional size, moving clockwise around the circle.
